fusions.name: Arrow-Straight Charge
fusions.desc: You rush up to 8 tiles to the target and drive into it for 12 damage, rising to twice that from full reach.

fusions.name: Held Until Loosed
fusions.desc: After a 1.5-second draw, looses a horn-tipped shaft that deals 30 damage to the first enemy it meets. It always lands as a critical hit.

fusions.name: Pawing the Ground
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow Draw
fusions.desc: The moment your stamina is full, your physical damage rises by 25% for 5 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
